reason: The arithmetic premise is right and every consequence drawn from it is measurably wrong. Geist's font box is 22px at 17px (fontBoundingBox ascent 17 + descent 5 = 1.294em) against a 20.4px line box, so half-leading is -0.8px and the two line rects do overlap by 1.61px in the box model. But boxes are not ink. Measured at 4x on the real master (Chromium, master.html?v=approach), the finding's own string set two lines in .b-title at 17px/20.4px: line-1 ink 3.50-18.75px, line-2 ink 25.00-37.25px - 6.25px of completely clear pixels between them, 37% of the em. Nothing overlaps, nothing clips, and nothing clips under the -webkit-line-clamp:2 overflow:hidden either (ink spans 3.50-37.25 inside a 40.78px box; one-line case ink 3.50-16.25 inside 20.39px). Geist's ink extents are 12px ascent / 2px descent at 17px (0.82em total), so a 20.4px advance has 6.4px of air; even a full-height accented cap (15px ink ascent) leaves 3.4px. The second claim inverts under the same measurement: the title-to-date white is 9.75px on the two-line row and 10.75px on a one-line row, against 6.25px between the title's own lines - the date is FARTHER from the words than the words are from each other, not tighter, so the stated 'reverse of the relationship every other pair draws' does not exist on the screen. Then the fix breaks the gate it claims to keep green. .b-title carries data-type="title", not "head", so the key is Geist|17|title - and the print state renders at data-medium="sheet" with a 17px title. Applying the proposed CSS verbatim at audit's own 1440x960 and re-deriving audit's roleKey across states gives Geist|17|title => 1.3 @phone, 1.3 @day, 1.2 @print. audit.mjs merges leadPairs across every state precisely to catch 'the same object standing on two baselines on two different states'; leadingRole would go from 0 to 1 and the gate would fail. It also makes the printed keepsake's leading tighter than the phone's, and it hands the audience surface - the one screen the brief says decides - a 1.7px-per-line looser setting to fix a collision that measurement says is not there. The leftover true observations (the leadingLadder branch in audit.mjs is dead code behind `if (false)`, so nothing grades a ratio against the face; the 3px margin is off the space ladder, whose nearest step is --gap-hair 4px) are a gate-coverage note and a 1px nudge, not a defect visible at the 9.5 bar - and the 1px would shave the measured title/date separation that is currently reading correctly.
sharpenedFix: Nothing to change in .b-title. If the panel wants the coverage gap closed rather than the type changed, the honest item is a different finding against audit.mjs: revive the dead `if (false)` leadingLadder branch, or add a check that grades line-height against the rendered face's fontBoundingBox ink extents rather than its em box - a leading under the box is only a defect when ink actually meets ink, which here it does not.
